services.name: Why TaeKwonDo
services.desc: We help build young strong well balanced individuals. Confident in themselves and prepared to deal with life challenges. To be successful in life you must find balance. The struggles and hardships students face throughout their journey to black belt will inoculate them to the stresses of life off the mats. Must teach students how to overcome fear and self-build confidence. Tae Kwon Do is a great venue to teach those benefits. As martial artists we will all encounter our fears, and quickly come to realize that they are what stands between us and progress toward our goal. services.name: after school
services.desc: Our Musa Martial Arts Summer Day Camp is a weekly camp designed especially for our junior members. Each day begins bright and early at 8:30~9:30 am drop-off and lasts until 4:00~5:30pm pickup. Our summer day camp emphasized on development of Self-confidence, Independence, Leadership, Coordination and Discipline, all in a Fun and Loving environments. Each day is packed with different activities and each week is designed around fun themes to keep them learning about different subjects. During the sessions, students receive specialized training in Martial Arts and are exposed to exciting games and drills for training their speed, reaction and technique.
